//: test: each command's --timeout is at least twice the slowest row or hook it ran under 8 busy loops on 2 CPUs at 61b66deb (two runs in a builds Job).

The first, 17000: read again at the round-3 class-search tree (main 46c275dcba with #4437's head e9d8f5075f and its uncommitted fixes), the whole command under the same load (two runs in builds Job d2-c9-ce, 2026-11-19): the fresh bundles contain only runtime builtin module specifiers, 7,115.80 and 8,211.25 ms, which the 15000 it had before held only 1.83 times; Bun prints no hook times, so no hook is read there. Before that, at 15000: a Legion pane's server registers on its transcript, claims its role, serves the legion tool and delivers through the inbox, 5,687.14 ms (the slowest hook, packed-skills.test.ts's beforeAll, 984.92 ms). The codex files main's #4406 added read later, under the same 8 loops: their slowest row, codex-owner.test.ts's two server processes racing for a dead owner's place, took 4,803.83 and 5,078.79 ms at d22477d9 (two runs in builds Job d5-8, 2026-11-19; 2,970.21 and 3,190.70 ms in d4-codex-8-3 at fdce4e94d2), under the 7,500 ms half of this guard. Read again at 6ca1a534 with #4437's fourth merge, the whole command under the same load with the files main's #4140 gave row timeouts of their own (two runs each in builds Jobs d8-ce-first-8 and d8-ce-first-8b): the slowest row, the fresh bundles contain only runtime builtin module specifiers, took 7,291.90 ms (6,991.86 ms in d8-ce-first-8b, once the 401 row held its two credential shares rather than waiting them out, 8,284.27 ms before).

The second, 120000: a turn that ends with a background task running earns no reminder, 19,096.00 ms here; envoy-channel-stall.test.ts runs only with LEGION_E2E_ENVOY_STACK=1, and there its rows took up to 53,001.47 ms (its beforeAll 14,816.41 ms) under the same load. channel-nats.test.ts (main's #4140) runs here too: its start that waits through a broker refusing connections took 12,293.66 ms in d8-ce-moved-8, above the first's half.

The third, 300000, runs codex-real.test.ts alone, which runs only where LEGION_TEST_CODEX names a Codex binary, and no CI job or builds Job has one: it is the 300,000 ms its beforeAll carried on main (#4406), not a reading.
